overview: SA EduSmart is a premium school management platform for S.A. Educational Institute in Manipur. It features a modern admin dashboard with student, teacher, and parent record management, attendance tracking, exam results with report cards, and an announcement system — all styled with a futuristic green, white, and gold glassmorphism design with dark/light mode.
features: Admin dashboard with analytics charts and quick actions
Student, teacher, and parent record management (CRUD)
Attendance marking and tracking with stats
Exam results, grade calculation, and report card generation
Green, white, and gold glassmorphism theme with dark/light mode
